column1: # The wire-watch denominator: every (driver, lane, connection mode) the
# weekly run owes a result for. scripts/wire_watch/matrix.py expands each
# row across the cases in scripts/drivers/cases/ (and, on a Bedrock lane,
# across the candidates in models.tsv) into run.json before anything runs,
# so a cell missing from a report is a row missing here, never a silent
# Columns (tab-separated, header row below this comment block):
#   driver            scripts/drivers/<driver>; a missing one is NOT_RUN(driver)
#   expected_ingress  the dialect the driver must reach routectl on, from
#   connection_mode   base-url, or front-proxy for a lane config with [mitm]
#   providers         the provider(s) whose ROUTECTL_DRIVER_<PROVIDER>_* refs
#   key_file          the file in the key directory holding that provider's
#                     credential is an OAuth seat or, on a Bedrock lane, the
#   sweep             `-`, or the lane config provider tables whose
#                     sweep-tier candidates this row runs. One row per
#                     provider table sweeps; every other row on a Bedrock
#                     lane runs that lane's primary model only.
# The plain api.openai.com lane (openai-compat.toml) is absent: no API key
# for it is held, so Chat Completions egress is covered by the Ollama
